content.stem: [反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划]根据巴塞尔委员会的原则,以下哪两项行动会使银行的客户身份识别计划更加完善？(选择两项.)

options.A: 了解客户为何选择某家特定的金融机构办理银行业务
options.B: 通过可靠的在线来源资料核实客户身份
options.C: 在新客户注册后的头两个月限制其在线活动
options.D: 了解新企业在银行开户的性质和目的

content.stem_en: According to the Basel Committee principles, which actions would make a customer identification program at a bank more robust? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Understanding why a customer has selected a particular financial institution for banking.
options_en.B: Verifying the identity of a customer with reputable online source documentation.
options_en.C: Limiting the online activities of a new customer during the first two months.
options_en.D: Understanding the nature and purpose behind a new business opening an account at the bank.
